description: This file defines the interface 'CodeValueWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting code values within the application.

classes.name: CodeValueWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for handling write operations related to code values such as create, update, and delete.

methods.name: createCodeValue
methods.description: Creates a new code value based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateCodeValue
methods.description: Updates an existing code value identified by codeValueId with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteCodeValue
methods.description: Deletes a specific code value identified by codeId and codeValueId.
